headline: TRD Associates advises Ravin Group on acquisition of Cable Corporation of India
sum: Ravin Infraproject Private Limited (of the Ravin Group) has acquired Cable Corporation of India Limited. TRD Associates advised Ravin Infraproject on the transaction, providing end-to-end legal assistance, including advising on the overall…
detail: Ravin Infraproject Private Limited (of the Ravin Group) has acquired Cable Corporation of India Limited. TRD Associates advised Ravin Infraproject on the transaction, providing end-to-end legal assistance, including advising on the overall structure, drafting and reviewing of the transactional documents, in addition to advising on the pending disputes. The transaction and disputes team was led by Teresa Daulat (Co-Founding Partner), with assistance Ayush Khandelwal (Senior Associate). Teresa Daulat The acquisition expands Ravin Group's portfolio and strengthens its position in the power and technology sector.
